source_snapshot.procedure: Install stress-ng or CPU vendor tool and stress both CPUs for 12 hours.
source_snapshot.criteria: No tool/BMC errors, hang or blue screen; CPU watts should match the max.
source_snapshot.gpt_v2: MANUAL ONLY; adds socket affinity, signed max-watt oracle, dew-point and RAS recovery controls.

old_problem: The pending question was a bindable CPU topology/workload/environment set plus an underspecified but owner-definable maximum-power oracle.
disposition_reason: ED-03 allows signed topology/profile bindings, ED-09 keeps chamber work manual, ED-14 preserves 12 hours, and ED-15 requires the project to bind max-watt domain/statistic/target/tolerance before PASS rather than keeping review pending.
decision_basis: Direct XLSX row39 all 18 columns, same-row DeepSeek, history3077 and actual next pending row41/history3078 were read.
CPU0 and CPU1 need core/NUMA/sensor mapping and socket-affined load floors so aggregate utilization cannot mask one socket.
The phrase 'match the max' is retained as a mandatory runtime oracle binding, never guessed.
Cold/high-rail evidence includes dew point, power, frequency, throttle, RAS and safe restoration; no action ran.

test_case.purpose: Verify CPU0 and CPU1 sustain approved socket-affined load and signed maximum-power behavior for 12 hours at cold/high-rail margin without compute, throttle-policy, RAS or platform failure.
required_package: Pinned stress tool/profile and per-socket load floor
test_case.test_command: Qualified staff establish dry 0C/+5% conditions, run the approved socket-affined 12-hour profile on CPU0 and CPU1, capture per-socket load/frequency/power/thermal/throttle/RAS telemetry, then warm dry and restore nominal state.
test_case.expected_result: Both sockets meet the signed load and maximum-watt oracle for the full interval with no disallowed compute, MCE/RAS, thermal, heartbeat or platform event and healthy restoration.
test_case.pass_fail_basis: PASS requires both sockets, full duration and the pre-approved watt domain/statistic/tolerance; aggregate CPU use or an invented 'max' value cannot pass.
safety_gate: Qualified chamber/high-rail operator and calibrated sensors
Abort on moisture, power/thermal, RAS or heartbeat limit
No auto-retry; warm above dew point before access
test_case.recovery: Stop on a signed limit, preserve evidence, return rails nominal, warm/dry above dew point, restore CPU policy and do not auto-retry.

source_conflict.reason: Sources consistently request dual-CPU stress; max-watt semantics are an explicit project binding.

blocked.reason: The method is safe once the signed oracle is bound.

pending.remaining_project_configuration: Bind CPU topology/profile, max-watt oracle, cold/high-rail tolerances, aborts and restoration.
pending.execution_status: REVIEW RESOLVED; MANUAL COLD-CHAMBER EXECUTION REQUIRED; NOT EXECUTED
pending.unlock_condition: Approve the signed runtime oracle and safety profile.

project_authority: Project owners define maximum-power semantics and acceptable cold behavior.
